parsed.work: Using the conditions in the text: BE = CF = DG = AH = 12 cm, so AE = BF = CG = DH = 17 − 12 = 5 cm. The four corner triangles are right triangles with legs 5 cm and 12 cm, so they are congruent (SAS). Each side of EFGH is √(5² + 12²) = 13 cm, so the perimeter is 4 × 13 = 52 cm.
